note: Fitness (Dave 2026-10-21): a character attribute, a whole number min to max (-10 to +10), 0 an average adult, that directly sets how fast exertion rises during strenuous activity (running, climbing, tool work, heavy loads): the rise per second is multiplied by exp(-fitness x strength), so +10 fitness at strength 0.05 raises exertion at about 61 percent of the normal pace (winded after about 1.65 times as long) and -10 at about 165 percent. Falling (recovery) is not touched. It is stored with the character in characters.json like luck. New characters start at default. Training (Dave 2026-10-21: starts fixed, trains slowly): the creation value is the base; any physical effort trains it like a skill (Dave 2 Nov 2026): effort above min_effort (walking, jogging, running, tool work, loads) earns a share of a point, 0 at min_effort up to 1 at full effort (running), a point per seconds_per_point of full-effort time (up to max_gain above the base, 10 = the whole range), and every decay_s_per_point seconds under min_effort takes one back, never below the base. set_fitness() sets the base and clears the training. Set strength to 0 to switch fitness off.
